title: Owner view reach law
description: The shared view of the framework umbrella leaves the product subtree out of what dependents of a framework module key. That is sound only while no framework module reaches into a product except in ways its own task or its crate closure covers: Cargo path dependencies are inferred project edges, Rust `#[path]` and `include*!` are followed by the crate source inputs, and a test is an own task of its module that keys the private directory itself. Every other reach must be listed with its reason.
